name: Nahamani
title: One of the leaders who returned from exile
summary: Nahamani was one of the Israelite leaders who returned to Judah from the Babylonian exile along with Zerubbabel. He is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah among the leading men who guided the first group of returning exiles. His role was connected to the rebuilding of the Jewish community after captivity.

keyEvents.title: Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Nahamani was among the leaders who returned to Judah from the Babylonian captivity along with Zerubbabel and other prominent men.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the leaders
keyEvents.description: Nahamani is named in the list of leading leaders who followed Zerubbabel back to the promised land, testifying to his prominent position among the people.

keyEvents.title: The Rebuilding of the Community
keyEvents.description: As one of the returning leaders, Nehemiah was part of the great work to restore the Jewish community, the temple, and the walls of Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: The Registration of the People
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah's name appears in connection with Nehemiah's registration of those who had returned, an important measure to preserve the people's identity and heritage.
